snp5.5:1.1: Mettagūmāṇavapucchā (4). "Pucchāmi taṃ Bhagavā, brūhi me taṃ, icc-āyasmā Mettagū maññāmi taṃ vedaguṃ bhāvitattaṃ: kuto nu dukkhā samudāgatā ime, ye keci lokasmiṃ anekarūpā". || ||
snp5.5:2.1: "Dukkhassa ve maṃ pabhavaṃ apucchasi, Mettagū ti Bhagavā taṃ te pavakkhāmi yathā pajānaṃ: upadhīnidānā pabhavanti dukkhā, ye keci lokasmiṃ anekarūpā. || ||
snp5.5:3.1: Yo ve avidvā upadhiṃ karoti, punappunaṃ dukkham upeti mando, tasmā hi jānaṃ upadhiṃ na kayirā dukkhassa jātippabhavānupassī". || ||
snp5.5:4.1: "Yan taṃ apucchimha akittayī no, aññaṃ taṃ pucchāmi, tad iṃgha brūhi: kathan nu dhīrā vitaranti oghaṃ jātijaraṃ sokapariddavañ ca, tam me munī sādhu viyākarohi, tathā hi te vidito esa dhammo". || ||
snp5.5:5.1: "Kittayissāmi te dhammaṃ, Mettagū ti Bhagavā diṭṭhe dhamme anītihaṃ yaṃ viditvā sato caraṃ tare loke visattikaṃ". || ||
snp5.5:6.1: "Tañ cāhaṃ abhinandāmi mahesi dhammam uttamaṃ, yaṃ viditvā sato caraṃ tare loke visattikaṃ". || ||
snp5.5:7.1: "Yaṃ kiñci sampajānāsi Mettagū ti Bhagavā uddhaṃ adho tiriyaṃ cāpi majjhe,| etesu nandiñ ca nivesanañ ca panujja viññāṇaṃ bhave na tiṭṭhe. || ||
snp5.5:8.1: Evaṃvihārī sato appamatto bhikkhu caraṃ hitvā mamāyitāni jātijaraṃ sokapariddavañ ca idh' eva vidvā pajaheyya dukkhaṃ". || ||
snp5.5:9.1: "Etābhinandāmi vaco mahesino sukittitaṃ Gotam' anūpadhīkaṃ, addhā hi Bhagavā pahāsi dukkhaṃ, tathā hi te vidito esa dhammo. || ||
snp5.5:10.1: Te cāpi nūna pajaheyyu dukkhaṃ, ye tvaṃ muni aṭṭhitaṃ ovadeyya, taṃ taṃ namassāmi samecca nāga, app-eva maṃ Bhagavā aṭṭhitaṃ ovadeyya". || ||
snp5.5:11.1: "Yaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ vedaguṃ ābhijaññā akiñcanaṃ kāmabhave asattaṃ, addhā hi so ogham imaṃ atāri, tiṇṇo ca pāraṃ akhilo akaṃkho, || ||
snp5.5:12.1: vidvā ca so vedagu naro idha, bhavābhave saṅgam imaṃ visajja| so vītataṇho anigho nirāso, atāri so jātijaran ti brūmī" ti || || METTAGŪMĀṆAVAPUCCHĀ NIṬṬHITĀ.
